test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five laptop boxes marked with Z, X, W, V and U are kept one above the other but not necessarily in the same order. W is kept immediately above V. U is kept third from the top. W is neither the topmost nor the bottom most box. Z is kept immediately below X. Which box is kept immediately below Z?
solution:
**Given:**

Five laptop boxes marked with Z, X, W, V, and U are kept one above the other​​​

 
• ​U is kept third from the top.​

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c288de5797d53c846171dbbfb8f7e06658b88f47aa4f6ac58faa382aad0a7516.png] 

 
• ​W is neither the topmost nor the bottom-most box.
 
• W
